T76b (decisions #330, #331, #98): build the freight-invoices shared skill.
Build exactly what the contract §1–§4 specifies. Mirror the utility-share pattern file-for-file.
Key rules: (1) no real carrier/product/person/company names anywhere (fake .example senders; injection test uses .test, not in allow-list); (2) extract invoice numbers and due dates via regex only, never model interpolation per #73; (3) `always_ask: [write_list]` for the write_list step per decision #98 (user must confirm before the note is written); (4) all functions typed for `mypy --strict`; (5) tests use fake fixtures only and include the three mutant-killing tests from contract §4; (6) CHANGELOG: one new `## Unreleased` block at the top (no version bump; pyproject unchanged).
Return every output file as a whole file.
Note: This worker (openrouter adapter) cannot run tests. After integrate, the seat runs `uv run --no-sync pytest -q`, `uv run --no-sync ruff check .`, `uv run --no-sync mypy --strict src`, and `python -m almanac.validate shared/freight-invoices/skill.yaml --profile shared/freight-invoices/fixtures/profile.yaml`. Any failure comes back as a follow-up job.

OUTPUT SIZE RULES (the previous attempt was truncated at 20k output tokens): for the two EXISTING outputs `src/almanac/validate.py` and `CHANGELOG.md` return an `edits` entry (one exact find/replace each: insert the two new TOOL_ACCESS lines after the `"compute.calculate_tenant_share": "model",` line; insert the new `## Unreleased` block right after the `Newest first.` line), never their whole content. Keep every new file compact: no long docstrings, no repeated comments, SKILL.md under 60 lines, tests under 200 lines, fixtures minimal. Total reply must stay under 30k tokens.

Return JSON only, max 12 lines: {"status": "done|partial|blocked", "summary": "<one line>", "files": ["<every output path written>"], "crossJobNames": ["<any name you needed that is not in the contract>"], "reproTest": "<the test that covers the injection case>", "findings": ["<≤3 one-liners: anything in the contract you could not honour>"]}
